answer_1.quote: we train a new model, called DREAM, to specifically answer these elaboration questions
answer_1.outputs: Scene elaborations (a 4-tuple of text: motivation, emotion, rule of thumb, consequence)

answer_4.quote: We use human evaluation using (mechanical Turk) crowdworkers.
answer_4.guideline: Workers rate each of the four components of the scene elaboration along 2 dimensions: SE accuracy and SE usefulness. Each component gets a score of 1 (yes) / 0.5 (a bit) / 0 (no). Also, workers rate the complete SE along SE consistency, measuring the fraction of sentences consistent with each other.
